about.body: NOVA is a full-service brand experience agency headquartered in Cairo. We combine creative strategy, flawless production, and fearless activation to build brands people remember — and love.

iei.body: We transform briefs into brand moments that move people — literally and emotionally. Every project begins with vision and ends with results.
cards: Every campaign starts with a question no one has asked yet. We dream before we plan.
A full in-house team and factory, and a relentless drive to build what others can't.
Brands don't just reach people — they move them.

sms.sub: Every campaign we build begins with a single question: what feeling do you want people to carry home?

steps.title: Brief & Discovery
steps.desc: We listen harder than anyone else in the room. Goals, audience, tension — we map it all before a single concept is drawn.

steps.title: Creative Strategy
steps.desc: Data meets intuition. We find the insight that makes your brand impossible to ignore — then build the story around it.

steps.title: Experience Design
steps.desc: From a napkin sketch to a full activation floor — every detail is designed to make people feel something real.

steps.title: Live & Measure
steps.desc: We execute flawlessly, then track what moved — because a great story is only great if people remember it tomorrow.

ffw.sub: Precision manufacturing, entirely in-house. Every booth, stand, counter and installation — built by us, delivered on time.

ybe.sub: Roadshows, retail activations, toll stations, in-store demos — we place your brand exactly where people are.
cards: Branded vehicles that travel city to city — turning every street into a stage for your campaign.
Pop-up activations inside malls and retail parks that pull shoppers in and turn browsers into brand fans.
Captive audiences at every gate — branded gantries, booth wraps and sampling while they wait.
Live demos inside stores — trained brand ambassadors who turn shelf browsers into buyers on the spot.

contact.body: Tell us your brand's next chapter. We'll handle the rest — from the first sketch to the final spotlight.
